name: vital-log
description: Obsidian plugin for logging vitamins, supplements, trackers, tally counters, and custom forms into your notes

scripts.build: tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.mkdirSync('dist',{recursive:true});['main.js','manifest.json','styles.css'].forEach(f=>fs.copyFileSync(f,'dist/'+f));console.log('dist/ updated')"
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
